architecture: Observed quaternion Hermite baseline; 637-feature RBF kernel learns four by 141 articulated residual coefficients
baseline: linear root and local quaternion SLERP through complete ancestor hierarchy
selection: Validation position + 0.1 rotation, include unlearned context baseline and frozen V3 incumbent; learned output must beat all baselines and original gates
notes: No new data or costs. All prior validation and development clips are observed, not fresh blind confirmation.
Surrounding rotations/root trajectories enter the baseline only via serialized observations.
Contextual quaternion Hermite is procedural and does not itself satisfy learned animation.
Model selection and promotion retain full original gates; no user-facing learned model promotion on failed results.
training_objective: Cohort-weighted regularized regression of complete curve coefficients fitted from training labels; temporal errors are acceptance metrics, not direct regression loss terms.
experiment: contextual quaternion Hermite baseline plus supervised full-hierarchy residual
